samples.question: Inside the pale route window is one connected navy route with a red start cap, a green end cap, and 31 amber station rings. Follow the route from red to green and straighten it by station order. Measure the 32 successive center-to-center station gaps; call the shorter gap 0 and the longer gap 1. Apply the binary first difference: keep gap 1 as the first output bit, then write 1 whenever a gap class differs from the preceding class. Lay the 32 output bits row-major into a 4-by-8 bitmap. Which displayed template is closer by Hamming distance: A) CREST = 00111100/01100110/11000011/11111111 or B) VAULT = 11111111/11000011/01100110/00111100? Choose A on a tie; quarantine a gap of at most 2. Ignore the caps, window, and marks outside it.
